preservedFailureEvidence.message: Waiting-worker fixture initially lacked precache/runtimeCaching; beforeAll failed, 8 tests did not execute. Added a non-mutating GET NetworkOnly route; rerun passed.

An exploratory repository typecheck reported unrelated concurrently edited tax-probe/workforce-test types and an envDir boolean widening. envDir now false as const; strict slice passes. This is not a full-repository passing assertion.

limitations: Production worker compiled through real Vite PWA configuration with envDir:false, but browser page is a local fixture using actual AuthContext/sync modules, not the complete Encho app.
Synthetic auth, inquiry and legacy bearer values only; no actual customer identity or server mutation performed.

Legacy fixture background-sync permission denied until replacement; retired sync explicitly dispatched through CDP after upgrade. This does not claim an already-running old worker can be recalled before an upgrade reaches it.
Already-dispatched network operations require canonical server authorization/revocation/idempotency and cannot be undone by deleting browser state.
Existing application/worker wholly offline cannot receive a patch; rollout requires update adoption and applicable server session response.
